T"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"he host's `0.1.1-rc.2` version and this plugin's `0.4.0` version are separate."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Data and limitations"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Paper identities, source observations, research questions, evidence, notes, claims, entities, obse"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"rvations, comparison protocols, and syntheses are stored in the selected profile's durable storage a"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"nd can be visible across sessions using that storage.
- Original PDF bytes and exact parsed revision"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"s are archived in profile storage and can be restored after restart. Back up the complete profile st"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"orage; a paper-library record alone is not an archive backup.
- PDF.js extracts native text only. Sc"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"anned documents need the optional Docling setup. OCR, formula, and chart outputs can contain recogni"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"tion errors and must be verified against the original; extraction is not scientific validation.
- Re"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"ading-pack recognition depends on extracted heading labels and approximate reading order. A missing "},{"id":"p28s9","text":"role does not establish that the paper omits the corresponding topic.
- Search and library matching "},{"id":"p28s10","text":"are lexical. The bundle does not provide semantic retrieval, remote DOI or arXiv verification, autom"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"atic claim clustering, or automatic entity resolution.
- Numeric observations and comparison protoco"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"ls are authored normalizations. Linking a protocol to a synthesis inference records its explicit com"},{"id":"p28s13","text":"parison basis; the bundle still does not silently convert units or aliases, rank results, calculate "},{"id":"p28s14","text":"deltas, infer statistical significance, or perform meta-analysis.
- `research_review_render` remains"},{"id":"p28s15","text":" a deterministic Markdown projection with exact hashes, offsets, and opt-in selected text. The works"},{"id":"p28s16","text":"pace additionally exports citation files and LaTeX through the report service; incomplete metadata a"},{"id":"p28s17","text":"nd evidence remain visible as warnings. Neither path grants publication approval.
- Task checkpoints"},{"id":"p28s18","text":" survive restart; running agent executions never silently restart. The execution service requires an"},{"id":"p28s19","text":" explicit trusted-client start, uses bounded steps/time/concurrency, and stops for required human re"},{"id":"p28s20","text":"view. Dedicated execution start/stop/history controls in the browser are not yet included; task crea"},{"id":"p28s21","text":"tion, progress inspection, pause, and resume are included."}],"truncated":true}
